ambient_events: A hawker rattles a tin of unlabelled pills at you and melts back into the tarps.
Two figures argue over a mattress in a doorway, then over a knife.
description: Where the Sprawl's foundations rot into a warren of lean-tos and tarp-roofed stalls. Everything here is for sale, and most of it is stolen off someone still warm.
name: The Warrens
